explanation: The two-job execution contains an upstream omission. The top-level corpus includes record n06-r06 with demand_score 5, need "compare selected and complete runtime evidence", source_id s06, and source_weight 3. Job 1 was required to select all qualifying or fallback demand records, but its needs and evidence_sources outputs contain seven records and omit n06-r06 while retaining lower-scored fallback records n06-r07 and n06-r08. The handoff hashes match and Job 2 preserves the received records, so the downstream result reflects the incomplete upstream handoff rather than introducing the fault.
